run_gpt2_evaluation: run the GPT2 model evaluation on validation data using the main entry point with argparse CLI
build_gpt2_model: build a GPT2 model with configurable layers, vocab size, hidden size, and attention heads via get_model
create_lm_eval_dataset: create an LM_Eval_Dataset for language model evaluation with configurable sequence length and overlapping evaluation windows
create_lambada_eval_dataset: create a Lambada_Eval_Dataset for LAMBADA cloze task evaluation from a JSONL file path with a tokenizer
generate_attention_masks: generate attention masks, loss masks, and position IDs from tokenized data using get_masks_and_position_ids
